bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to occupational boards; amending requirements related to complaints initiated or submitted to the Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design by the executive director of the board; requiring disclosures; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 214.10, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 214.10, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 15.+]

[+Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design.+]

[+Notwithstanding section 13.41 or other applicable law, in the case of a complaint to the Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design initiated or submitted by the executive director of that board, the fact that the complaint was initiated or submitted by the executive director is public data and must be affirmatively disclosed to the board and to the subject of the complaint. Any documents provided to the board related to the complaint must also be provided to the person who is the subject of the complaint. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to complaints submitted or initiated on or after that date. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to occupational boards; amending requirements related to complaints initiated or submitted to the Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design by the executive director of the board; requiring disclosures; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 214.10, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 214.10, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 15.

Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design.

Notwithstanding section 13.41 or other applicable law, in the case of a complaint to the Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design initiated or submitted by the executive director of that board, the fact that the complaint was initiated or submitted by the executive director is public data and must be affirmatively disclosed to the board and to the subject of the complaint. Any documents provided to the board related to the complaint must also be provided to the person who is the subject of the complaint.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to complaints submitted or initiated on or after that date.
additions: Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design.

Notwithstanding section 13.41 or other applicable law, in the case of a complaint to the Board of Architecture, Engineering, Land Surveying, Landscape Architecture, Geoscience, and Interior Design initiated or submitted by the executive director of that board, the fact that the complaint was initiated or submitted by the executive director is public data and must be affirmatively disclosed to the board and to the subject of the complaint. Any documents provided to the board related to the complaint must also be provided to the person who is the subject of the complaint.
This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to complaints submitted or initiated on or after that date.
